//: WHAT THIS SCREEN SAYS IN ITS OWN WORDS. The sentences the domain composes are NOT here: the door brings those already said, in the language it was asked for. Keys are exactly the ones in es-CR.json. Product descriptions, branch names and receipt numbers come from the supermarket's record and are never translated: an English screen that says «leche» is correct. The supermarket's own name and tagline are not translated either — they are the institution's voice. {clave} is a hole the code fills.

inicio.permisoCaduca: Your folder is «{carpeta}». The browser asks you to confirm write permission every time you reopen the app.
inicio.guardaEnTuCarpeta: This app keeps your purchases in a folder of yours. Pick the folder and the app writes its record there; nobody else reads it.
inicio.modoCarpetaDa: It stays on your disk, and your assistant can read it.
inicio.sinSelector: This browser has no folder picker.
inicio.modoNavegadorDa: It is also saved and survives closing, but the browser manages it: your assistant cannot read it.
inicio.contextoInseguro: This page is not a secure context, and the browser turns off both ways of saving. Come in over https or localhost and both appear. It is not your browser's fault.
inicio.sinAlmacenamiento: This browser cannot save anything permanently. The app still works, but the record lives only in memory and is lost on closing.
inicio.migrada: Your new purchases now come in through {donde}, on this same phone. What you see here stays and is still yours; what this copy stops doing is looking for news.
inicio.hospedada: It is being saved on this phone. Your record is yours and it is here: Gnothi gave this supermarket a folder on your phone, and your assistant can read it from there.
inicio.sinCarpeta: Nothing is being saved. This app is running without a folder: what you see is asked of the provider again every time you open it, and no record of yours stays on disk.
inicio.escrituraRechazada: The folder refused the write. What you see on screen is not saved in «{carpeta}». It is usually the permission, which expires on reopening.
